hooks.command: d="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; [ -n "$d" ] || d="$(pwd)"; { [ -f "$d/docs/index.html" ] && [ -f "$d/dev/check.js" ]; } || exit 0; if [ -f "$d/src/index.html" ] && [ -f "$d/dev/build.js" ]; then b=$(node "$d/dev/build.js" 2>&1) || { echo "$b" >&2; exit 2; }; fi; s="$d/.claude/.idxhash"; h=$(shasum -a1 "$d/docs/index.html" | cut -d' ' -f1); [ "$h" = "$(cat "$s" 2>/dev/null)" ] && exit 0; printf %s "$h" > "$s"; out=$(node "$d/dev/check.js" 2>&1) || { rm -f "$s"; echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
